# Local Reveal and PPDS plugin assets

The files in `ivo-common/` were copied from Ivo Kvistgaard's [PPDS slide common directory](https://kvistgaard.github.io/slides/common/) on 26 November 2026. The SVGs in `ivo-assets/` came from the [source deck assets](https://kvistgaard.github.io/slides/assets/). They are kept locally so the v3 deck and custom plugins can be developed and tested in this repository. Reveal.js and its standard plugins are distributed under their upstream licenses; Ivo's custom files remain attributed to their source.

The live PPDS data and services are loaded from their original URLs and are not copied into this repository.
